metadata.case_name: CHEUNG KWONG HON v. NIXON CLEANING CO LTD AND OTHERS

injuries.description: fracture of his right distal tibia
source: X-ray revealed a fracture of his right distal tibia.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower end of tibia

manifestations.description: on and off attacks of pain, especially after prolonged walking, stair climbing and heavy lifting, etc.
4-5% impairment for the whole person for residual pain after fracture of right distal tibia (Dr. Wong); 1% (Dr. Yip).

treatments_received: admitted to the Kwong Wah Hospital
Open reduction and internal fixation of the right distal tibia performed on 15.3.2007
treatments_future: operation to remove the nail in his right foot

losses.description: Residual pain after fracture of right distal tibia causing on and off attacks of pain, especially after prolonged walking, stair climbing and heavy lifting; assessed as 4-5% whole person impairment by Dr. Wong and 1% by Dr. Yip.
